protocol.features: Production footballForm, computed 3 hours before historical kickoff; 365-day history, maximum 20 games; no outcome added until after extraction
protocol.fit: Regularized Poisson goal regression with shared attack/defense coefficients and per-side intercepts, plus bounded Dixon-Coles low-score correction; optimize joint goal negative log likelihood on training only
protocol.select: Minimum 1X2 log loss on 2024 selection set; no refit after selection
protocol.uncertainty: Paired week-block bootstrap, 1000 replicates, fixed seed 20260927; intervals are descriptive, not a separate tuning signal
prohibitions: no fitting on holdout or recent audit
no manual parameter changes based on holdout
no ROI claim without betting odds
no calibrated label for rejected leagues

limitations: Retrospective scores captured in 2026 are not archived pregame feed snapshots.
No lineup, injury, xG, bookmaker odds or profit validation.
Chronological holdout improvement is not a guaranteed future win rate.
New Champions League entrants and promoted teams may still lack five valid same-competition results.
